notes.title: Full version - Release Patch 1.0
notes.content:
On August 19, 2020 at 4 PM (UTC +1), the premiere of Beat Me will take place! on Steam.
The price of the game will be 14.99 $, where in the first week you can buy it with a 10% discount.

So we encourage you to buy and publish your GIFs and screenshots on Discord or Steam Community.

Changes that will be brought by the "Realease 1.0" update:
- adding a new playable character - Geisha
- adding new levels
- a new aspect of stage competition with the players' scores
- location improvement
- correction of network bugs
- optimization of some scenes
- adding the ability to mute chat or voice chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35972317/39786d2f36fb42b37b063c75872d74dbb9152370.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta patch 1.6
notes.content:
Beta version 1.6
- added new scenes (castle and wild west)
- added wave mode
- added steam leader board for wave mode
- added new stats scene with new stuff
- added new health bar
- added perfect block system. If you play melee characters and use the block at the right time, you can change the direction of the incoming projectile. This skill has a cooldown
- added dual shock light setup - depending on player color
- added pad vibration
- added localization system (for now only english and polish, more languages soon)
- fixed music on some levels and some errors related to music
- fixed some bugs related to networking and joining the room
- fixed player name in the lobby
- fixed lack of glyphs while xinput is disable
- improved menu scene (graphics, animations, etc.)
- improved curtains open/close time
- improvement player hint
- improvement block (now u can block in the air)
- improvement online sync on some levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35972317/d1a56a44563d0715d66630ef65b05cc60aaf317f.png[/img]

notes.title: Beta version 1.3
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Added physics force to characters' attack (Now every weapon add force to physical objects)
- Added characters' physics response to hit of weapons
- Added possibility to change monitor in Video Settings
- Nerfed Skeleton ultimate. Previously, the curse always lasted 4.5s. Now, depending on the distance from the opponents to the Skeleton, it lasts from 4.25s to 1.35s (the further away from the Skeleton, the shorter it lasts). If there is a Demon in the game, the curse only affects him. But the curse only works for 3.6s and does not decrease the Demon's HP
- Fixed problem with stucking characters behind obstacles
- Fixed incorrect Knight ultimate's damage
- Fixed out of map killer on Pirate's Sink level
- Fixed problem with syncing characters' impact effects via network
- Fixed problem with syncing weapons' doubled animations via network
- Fixed rocket's explosion, damage and problem with synchronization via network
- Fixed character shaking after death (online game)
- Fixed multiple shoot when lags (online game)
- Fixed Archer's arrow collisions at closed range
- Disabled resolution dialog on start

notes.title: Beta patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thanks to our community we found a lots of variety bugs that we recently have fixed.

Changelog:

- Added "Quick Match" option (Online Game)
- Added possibility to send game log file (Main Menu Scene)
- Fixed many bugs related to joining an online game (black screen, dark screen, failed to join, disappeared objects)
- Fixed invisible mouse in Menu
- Fixed stat's scene sync problem (Online Game)
- Improved waiting for the online game to start (now you can see what is happening on scene right now, like players, boosters, etc.)
- Improved character physics stability
- Changed online room type to public by default

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35972317/5c18810d4f2e42c672ba3c1c37eb9278ef3a06a9.png[/img]
